multi_curve_split_2026_10_28.scope: Split multiple curve targets with one or more cutting curves in one transaction, preserving unhit targets; focused geometry and controller Undo/Redo tests.
multi_curve_split_2026_10_28.limitations: Actual UI Undo/Redo replay, different placements, multi-target Trim, surfaces and BReps remain open.

split_point_join_many_2026_10_28.scope: Split Point for a preselected line; Join three or more connected BReps; focused geometry, failure and Undo/Redo tests.
split_point_join_many_2026_10_28.limitations: General or closed curves, complex topology, mixed inputs and multi-target Split/Trim remain open.

join_brep_2026_10_28.scope: Two BRep sewing with explicit document tolerance in world coordinates, one transaction; adjacent and disconnected box-face fixtures and Undo/Redo.
join_brep_2026_10_28.limitations: More than two BReps, raw surfaces, mixed inputs and broader topology remain unverified or unsupported.

explode_brep_2026_10_28.scope: OCCT BRep polysurfaces are split into exact face BReps with preserved placement in one transaction; single faces are refused.
explode_brep_2026_10_28.limitations: Box fixture only; other documented Explode types and wider Join/Split/Trim gaps remain open.

remaining: Cutters must share the target placement; several cutters accumulate until Enter.
The default build uses OCCT exact curve/face intersections for a BRep cutter; no-default refuses it with a typed error rather than approximating display triangles.
Trim keeps the complement of the picked interval; the pick is a point.
Join orders by endpoint continuity and refuses gaps.
Interactive M03-UI acceptance of the toolbar and point prompts is not performed by the implementer.
